items.stem: A trainer says 'I covered the whole topic in the video, so the learners must have learned it.' What is the flaw?

options.text: Covering content does not guarantee that learning occurred
options.rationale: Correct: learning is evidenced by what learners can do, not by what was presented.
Video is an effective medium; coverage alone is the issue.

options.text: Topics should never be covered fully
options.rationale: Thorough coverage is fine; the error is equating it with learning.
This is precisely the mistaken assumption being flagged.

items.explanation: Correct: learning is evidenced by what learners can do, not by what was presented.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which techniques help manage cognitive load in a video lesson? (Select TWO)

options.text: Breaking a long topic into short, focused segments
options.rationale: Correct: chunking reduces the load on working memory.

options.text: Removing redundant on-screen text that duplicates narration
options.rationale: Correct: cutting redundancy avoids the split-attention effect.

options.text: Packing every related detail into one continuous video
options.rationale: This overloads learners and reduces retention.

options.text: Speaking as fast as possible to save time
options.rationale: Excessive pace increases load and harms comprehension.

items.explanation: Correct: chunking reduces the load on working memory.

items.stem: A quiz item asks about a statistic that never appeared in the lesson. Which assessment principle does this violate?

options.text: Alignment of assessment to what was taught and to the outcomes
options.rationale: Correct: fair assessment tests the stated outcomes, not untaught trivia.
Format is not the issue; alignment is.

options.text: The rule that quizzes must be timed
options.rationale: Timing is unrelated to this flaw.
Randomisation does not address testing untaught content.

items.explanation: Correct: fair assessment tests the stated outcomes, not untaught trivia.
